query:
update connection
            set group_name = case
                when group_name = $1 then $2
                when $2 = '' then substr(group_name, length($1) + 2)
                else $2 || substr(group_name, length($1) + 1)
            end
            where group_name = $1 or substr(group_name, 1, length($1) + 1) = $1 || '/'
